description: This file contains an abstract class 'ConnectionFactory' responsible for creating and managing network connections within the Orleans framework. It handles connection configuration, building, and asynchronous connection establishment for silo addresses.

classes.name: ConnectionFactory
classes.description: An abstract class that defines the blueprint for connection factories managing network connections in Orleans.

methods.name: ConfigureConnectionBuilder
methods.description: Virtual method allowing subclasses to customize the connection builder.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Abstract method to create a connection for a given silo address and connection context.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Method to asynchronously establish a connection to a silo address using the connection factory.
